name: company
label: Company URL name
description: The tenant the token is for. Sent as CompanyUrlName and as the company claim.

name: kid
label: Key id
description: The kid of the key in the service's keyring (CROSS_SERVICE_KEYRING_*).

name: secret
label: Secret
description: The key from the keyring, base64 as stored in SSM. Tick the box below for a plain-text secret.

name: secretPlain
label: Secret is plain text, not base64

name: audience
label: Audience
description: The service that verifies the token (aud): go-core, ai-api, sync-api.

name: actSub
label: Act as user id
description: Numeric user id to impersonate (act.sub). Leave empty for a service call.
